articles.title: Jev is Vercel’s fastest-adopted AI model ever
articles.summary: The data comes from Vercel's AI gateway, a unified API service similar to OpenRouter.
articles.paragraph: The data comes from Vercel's AI gateway, a unified API service similar to OpenRouter. AI Jev is Vercel’s fastest-adopted AI model ever Russell Brandom 8:33 AM PDT · October 16, 2026 Jev has become the fastest adopted AI model ever — at least by some measures. Vercel data published on Thursday shows that, within two weeks of its launch, the buzzy decision model was being used by 35% of paid teams, with nearly double the reach of the second most popular model, Sonnet 5.5. It’s the fastest adoption a model has ever seen in its first two weeks, according to Vercel’s data, and a major accomplishment for the model’s creators, TypeSafe AI. Published in limited release on September 15, Jev is designed as a lightweight tool for choosing between a few predetermined outputs.

articles.title: Maybe Chatbots Shouldn’t Get to Say ‘I’ or ‘Me’
articles.summary: MIT professor Sherry Turkle warns that people have become dangerously enmeshed with chatbots.
articles.paragraph: MIT professor Sherry Turkle warns that people have become dangerously enmeshed with chatbots. LoaderSave StorySave this storyCommentLoaderSave StorySave this storyDuring four decades of studying the effects of interaction with computers, Sherry Turkle has developed a reputation as a careful if critical social scientist who approaches her work with academic rigor and distance. Her new book, Artificial Intimacy: Who We Become When We Talk to Machines, breaks this mold. It is a polemic warning that we have reached a state of emergency where our humanity is at risk from overreliance on soulless machines who pose as our tutors, mentors, friends, colleagues, and lovers.

articles.title: Thousands of specialized engineers deployed by AWS, Anthropic to prove AI is worth the investment
articles.summary: Multiple AI giants have launched their own FDE schemes, but consultancies are also proving to be a vital part of the chain.
articles.paragraph: AI companies are focusing on FDEs We've already surpassed the point that model capabilities were the limit – now, companies are struggling with legacy infrastructure and identifying real-world use cases, so AI developers are getting involved to help them out. As part of the ongoing shift in how AI is being sold, those developers are no longer just selling their AI to customers – they're also taking responsibility over its deployment. Already, we've seen OpenAI backing its FDE business with a massive $4 billion investment and AWS footing a $1 billion bill for FDEs, while Anthropic shared plans to train 10,000 specialist engineers by the end of 2027.

articles.title: The flying Tesla Roadster is an overbaked idea from my least favorite person
articles.summary: Elon Musk finally unveiled his-long-promised rocket-powered, flying Roadster, and it's exactly what we don't need right now.
articles.paragraph: Elon Musk finally unveiled his-long-promised rocket-powered, flying Roadster, and it This stemmed from long before he became a supervillain, and was instead no more than an oddball tech-sector genius primed to become a real-life Tony Stark. It was at the tail-end of this honeymoon, in 2017, that Musk unveiled the Tesla Roadster 2020, a luxury model EV that promised insane specs and performance (0-to-60mp in 1.9 seconds) and maybe even something we’d only dreamed of: rockets that might let it fly. Now, for chronology sticklers, Musk did not promise rockets during Tesla's November 2017 event; it was was primarily devoted to the Tesla Semi.

articles.title: Ancient fungus unlocks secret support system in major food crops that could transform farming practices
articles.summary: Arabidopsis thaliana, a small flowering mustard plant used worldwide as the primary genetic model in plant biology, was long believed incapable of forming relationships with underground fungal network...
articles.paragraph: Arabidopsis thaliana, a small flowering mustard plant used worldwide as the primary genetic model in plant biology, was long believed incapable of forming relationships with underground fungal networks. New research published in Current Biology led by professor Katie Field demonstrates for the first time that it can establish a fully functional, resource-sharing partnership with an ancient soil fungus known as a Mucoromycotina fine root endophyte (MFRE).

articles.title: CFTC Wants to Drop Gemini’s $5M Settlement. A Judge Just Said No
articles.summary: The judge ruled that a shift in the CFTC’s enforcement priorities and misconduct allegations against its enforcement division weren’t enough to reopen a deal Gemini signed weeks before trial.
articles.paragraph: A federal judge has refused to let the Winklevoss twins’ crypto exchange Gemini walk back a $5 million settlement with the CFTC. A federal judge has refused to let the Winklevoss twins’ crypto exchange Gemini walk back a $5 million settlement with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission, even though the regulator itself had joined the exchange in asking him to toss it out. In a ruling issued Oct. 15, U.S. District Judge Alvin Hellerstein of the Southern District of New York denied the unusual joint motion to vacate a consent order Gemini agreed to in January 2025. He found that neither a shift in the CFTC’s enforcement priorities under the current administration nor allegations of misconduct inside the agency’s enforcement division met the legal bar to reopen a signed judgment.

articles.paragraph: Technical indicators suggest the bullish trend for Bitcoin price remains intact, but prediction market traders are sending mix signals. Bitcoin is trading at $82,295, up 1.28% in 24 hours, after a Thursday slide below $80,000, its first dip under that level in more than a month. Ethereum gained 4.17% to $2,473.17, Solana rose 3.02%, and XRP added 2.03%. Zcash is the strongest of the top 15 largest coins, jumping 10.29% to $1,222.02, lifting its market cap to $20.67 billion, and roughly erasing the almost 10% it lost on Thursday. In general, the market is bouncing today after spending most of the week heading in the other direction. Thursday's drop triggered $948 million in liquidations, 90.6% of them longs, per CoinGlass data.

articles.title: Three Canadian Armed Forces Members Charged in Kidnapping of Crypto Exchange Owner
articles.summary: Police seized guns, silencers and more than 2,000 rounds of ammunition, nearly all of it allegedly stolen from the Canadian military.
articles.paragraph: Police seized guns, silencers and more than 2,000 rounds of ammunition, nearly all of it allegedly stolen from the Canadian military. Toronto police have arrested seven men, three of them members of the Canadian Armed Forces, over the abduction of the owner of a cryptocurrency exchange, the Toronto Police Service announced on Wednesday. Investigators have laid 82 charges, including kidnapping for ransom and numerous firearms offenses. Police did not name the victim or the exchange. Seven men arrested. Firearms and thousands of rounds of ammunition seized.
